items.title: Jonathan Taylor: May soon be on the move
items.text:
The Colts are fielding trade offers for Taylor, and while the asking price currently appears to be "too high," a deal seems likely to happen, per NFL reporter Jordan Schultz.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dalton Kincaid: Trending toward playing Sunday
items.text:
The Bills are optimistic that Kincaid (chest), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens, will be able to play, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DJ Moore: On track for return Sunday
items.text:
Moore (shoulder) remains listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens but is expected to play, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Breece Hall: Not expected to play Sunday
items.text:
Hall (quadriceps), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Raiders, isn't expected to play, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kenny Gainwell: Expected to play Sunday
items.text:
Gainwell (hip) is in line to play in Sunday's game against the Falcons, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN reports.
